text: Entry 1489 ships both configured DXC and DXIL DLL names under MOZ_DXCOMPILER. At the fixed accepted revision this block contains only MOZ_DXC_DLL_NAME. Preserve the build guard and configured filename boundary, but do not describe the two historical entries as the current package contents. The intervening packaging changes and the paired Gecko build were not fully studied. Static source and test-code inspection only.
